logoRules: The logo is the wordmark "BRANDED" (bold, blue gradient) above "GENIUS" (bold, silver/metallic gradient) with a short line on each side of "GENIUS".
Approved versions: full colour, dark logo (white lettering on dark grey), white-background logo (black lettering), and greyscale logo (grey lettering on dark grey).
Keep the bold lettering, the metallic effect and the colour gradients; they carry the professional, tech-forward look.
The guide shows the logo on A4 and A5 letterhead, envelopes and business cards.
imageStyle: Clean, modern and tech-forward: light grey or white backgrounds, royal and sky blue accents, silver/metallic highlights, generous white space and bold, simple headlines.
do: Use only the four brand colours: Royal Blue, Sky Blue, Medium Gray and White.
Pair blue gradients with silver/metallic tones, as in the logo.
Use Futura Bold for headings and Futura Medium for sub-headings.
Use one of the approved logo versions that contrasts with the background.
On dark backgrounds use the dark logo version (white lettering); on light backgrounds the full-colour logo.
dont: Don't use the Good Times logo font for headings or body text.
Don't recolour the logo outside the brand palette.
Don't stretch, rotate, crop or add effects to the logo.
